summary.delivery_denominators: All positions: nonzero requests for fidelity, realized nonzero edits for norm

efficacy_denominators.selected_suppression: selected_before; undefined values retained as unavailable

summary.eligibility: Native before > 0 and nonspecial; shared by both signs and both encoder paths

historical_replay.scope: Cross-hardware native differences are measured, not an implementation-failure gate

summary.reconstruction_scope: Original clean-state reconstruction, not edited-state reconstruction
summary.scope: Descriptive engineering on previously observed historical splits, not fresh validation or behavioral assay qualification. Tokens are correlated within texts; no token-independent confidence intervals are computed.

throughput.scope: Saved per-state compute times; excludes provisioning, SAE load, barriers and retrieval

verification_scope: Input/receipt hashes, saved-row consistency and continuous projection reconstruction; native telemetry is not independently recomputed from SAE weights
